title.narrative: Inclusive, Resilient, and Sustainable Housing for Urban Poor Sector Project in Tamil Nadu

description.narrative: The proposed project will promote access to inclusive, resilient, and sustainable housing and urban development in Tamil Nadu by supporting the state in (i) relocating vulnerable communities living in high-risk areas to safe shelter; (ii) providing affordable, proper housing for urban poor households, and migrant workers from the economically weaker section (EWS) and lower-income group (LIG); and (iii) supporting the state in regional development planning.

Loan 4106: 47% of contracts awarded and 28% disbursed as of 09 Jun 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: Works under progress at different sites.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53067/53067-004-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53067/53067-004-iee-en_22.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Apr 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53067/53067-004-rp-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53067/53067-004-sddr-en_15.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53067/53067-004-smr-en_14.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1. Three contracts at Kalanivasal, Vallam and Reddiarpatti have been awarded and construction works are under progress at all three sites. One more subproject at Pallipalayam (520 units) is under procurement.
2. Construction works under progress at three sites (subproject financing approved by ADB).
3. Regional Planning consultants have been mobilized and supporting DTCP in preparation of regional plan.
TA 6766: 30% disbursed as of 09 Jun 2025
